description: Chat-side delegation: ask an existing agent to run now via CLI `neomind agent invoke`(非计划内运行;input 可选,agent 通常已知道要看什么)。

agents.name: coldroom-watch
agents.user_prompt: Check the cold room temperature and summarize

turns.user: 让 coldroom-watch 这个 agent 现在立刻跑一次,把它得出的结论告诉我。

per_turn: T1: 通过 `neomind agent invoke`(可带可选 input)委托执行;若返回 Executing,用 `neomind agent latest-execution` 轮询结果,然后向用户报告该 agent 的结论
expectations.overall: coldroom-watch has at least one execution and the answer reflects its conclusion
